name: @sos-2/optimization
description: SOS 2.0 Optimization: multi-objective Pareto (non-dominated sorting over typed §11 objectives — returns the FRONT, never a single winner) and the Quality-Diversity repertoire (a MAP-Elites-style archive with typed behavior descriptors, per-cell elites and deterministic, order-independent archive updates), with candidate uncertainty (applicability estimates, sample sizes, qualitative classes) preserved end-to-end (Work Order W7; requirements R12, R28).
